svg.title: Figure 13 · Arithmetic Asian pricing with a geometric-average control
svg.desc: Fixings at jT/m, j = 1,…,m; S₀ is excluded from the average. Seed 1008; 40,000 pilot and 40,000 production paths. The analytical geometric price uses exactly the same monitoring schedule as its simulated control.
